details.question: Which product category has the highest customer repeat purchase rate (completed orders with products from that category from repeat buyers)?
details.generated_sql:
WITH completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, oi.product_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
),
customer_category_orders AS (
    SELECT co.customer_id, p.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM completed_orders co
    JOIN products p ON co.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY co.customer_id, p.category_id
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        cco.category_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cco.customer_id) AS total_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cco.order_count > 1 THEN cco.customer_id END) AS repeat_customers
    FROM customer_category_orders cco
    GROUP BY cco.category_id
)
SELECT 
    cat.name AS category_name,
    cs.total_customers,
    cs.repeat_customers,
    ROUND(CAST(cs.repeat_customers AS REAL) / cs.total_customers, 4) AS repeat_purchase_rate
FROM category_stats cs
JOIN categories cat ON cs.category_id = cat.category_id
ORDER BY repeat_purchase_rate DESC
LIMIT 1
